entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-05-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Dotnetup: Support listing available daily builds #54299
  • Dotnetup: Support installing daily builds via channel #54298
  • osx-arm64 SDK 11.0.100-preview.5.26263.103 ships dSYM in place of libdotnet-aot.dylib #54296
  • mslearn's xrefmap.json file is missing a few types #54293
  • Feature request: Allow authors to customize the order of `dotnet new list` templates #54289
  • The PublishRuntimeIdentifier MSBuild property should be documented #54283
  • All `dotnet` command takes ~4.4s on .NET 11 preview 4 (Windows) #54282
  • Dotnetup: Skip signature validation for daily builds, but display warning #54278

Closed

  • Install Nightly SDK Builds with DNUP #51097
  • Implicit using for console apps and ASP.NET Core don't match #33997
  • RuntimeIdentifier does not propagate to dependency projects when multi-targeting TFMs #10625
  • Publish output goes to the wrong folder if OutputPath is overridden and doesn't have a trailing slash #907
    Backlog
  • CopyBuildOutputToPublishDirectory does not prevent deps.json from being copied to output directory #904
    Backlog
  • CopyBuildOutputToPublishDirectory not respected by P2P's #902
    Backlog
  • Resource names generated based off of CSProj name #895
    Backlog
  • Attempting to run a NetStandard class library that's been turned into a console app shows an error about "RunCommand" missing #833
    Backlog
  • Sdk.targets should give a warning if user is multi-targeting and have overridden certain properties #789
    Backlog
  • Fix `dotnetup` telemetry with new otel platform + dashb #52785
  • Sign the DNUP Windows Executable in a Pipeline #51091

Created

  • [draft] `dotnetup` verifies release signatures #54300
  • Add AOT tests for NativeAOT CLI entry point #54297
  • Add `dotnet test` device selection support for MAUI #54295
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Fix CA1825 false positive on collection expressions #54294
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #54292
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add escape hatch for PublishRuntimeIdentifier being appended to RuntimeIdentifiers by default #54291
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #54290
  • Skip flaky/broken tests on release/10.0.4xx #54277

Merged

  • dotnetup daily builds (Phase 1): blob feed fallback for fully-specified prerelease versions #54224
  • Align `Microsoft.NET.Sdk` implicit usings with ASP.NET Core by adding `System.Net.Http.Json` for net11+ #54272
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Fix `dotnet tool exec` / `dnx` failing when tool exists in `dotnet-tools.json` but not yet restored #53658
    Servicing-approved, backport
  • Migrate ShowPreviewMessage to IMultiThreadableTask #53956
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'release/10.0.1xx' #54284
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.4xx' => 'main' #54271
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #54285
  • Sign dotnetup executable for Windows and Mac #54059
    dotnetup

Updated

  • Fix UWP XBF files losing subdirectory paths in resources.pri when UseArtifactsOutput is enabled #53867
  • Delete unused resources from CliCommandStrings #53858
  • Fix arm64 macOS CI installing x64 runtimes under Rosetta 2 #54253
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add --allow-prerelease and --no-sdk-version options to dotnet new globaljson template #54133
  • Warn when MetadataUpdaterSupport is false in dotnet watch #54264
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Backport Copilot CLI telemetry env detection to release/10.0.1xx #54276
